name: Null
source:
'Null' is a murder mystery / social deduction game with time travel elements.

"You" are trapped in a mansion with 8 other people forced to play a game with some "Werewolf/Mafia" elements except the consequences are very real. But wait, that's not all, every time you die in the game you are sent back to the start of the loop forever trapped in a hellish game with no means to escape.

But fear not, you're not alone. "CC" a strange girl who seems to also retain her memories after each loop is also seeking an escape. Would you two be able to escape this hellish nightmare or would you be forced to repeat the same loop over and over again for all eternity? 

Who's this "Zero" person and why is she forcing you to play this sick game? 

Why does your character have hollow creepy eyes and barely talks? 

Discover not only the truth about this twisted game and your universe but also the terrible truth about "YOU"!

[Edited from [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/null]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Null》是一款包含时间旅行要素的谋杀悬疑／社交推理游戏。

“你”和另外8个人被困在一座宅邸里，被迫参加一场带有“狼人杀／黑手党”元素的游戏，只不过后果都是真实的。还不止如此：你每次在游戏中死亡，都会回到循环起点，永远被困在这场无法逃脱的地狱游戏里。

不过别害怕，你并非孤身一人。“CC”是一名奇怪的女孩，她似乎也能在每次循环后保留记忆，并正在寻找逃脱的方法。你们能否逃离这场地狱般的噩梦，还是会被迫永远重复同一个循环？

“Zero”究竟是谁？她为什么强迫你玩这场病态的游戏？

你的角色为什么有一双空洞、令人毛骨悚然的眼睛，而且几乎不说话？

揭开这场扭曲游戏和你所在宇宙的真相，同时发现关于“你”本人的可怕秘密！

[改写自[url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/null]Itch.io[/url]]
